en: From a playable game to a cultural business
zh: 从可玩的游戏，到持续经营的文化产品
en_script:
You've seen what Civilization Voyage feels like to play.
I'll now explain how we plan to make it a business that can keep growing.
We used Lovable to share ideas, Claude for design, Codex for APIs, and Grok for the frontend and 3D scenes.

But a working game is only the beginning.
For this project to go further, people need a reason to choose it, pay for it, and use it again.
That's what our business plan is built around.
We plan to sell the game to players, offer teaching support to schools, and build local story experiences for museums.
It all starts with what makes Civilization Voyage worth choosing.
zh_script: 大家已经体验了文明航程。接下来我讲怎么把它发展成能够继续成长的业务。我们用Lovable交流想法，Claude做设计，Codex处理API，Grok负责前端和3D。但做出游戏只是开始。项目要走下去，用户需要有理由选择、付费、再回来，商业计划就围绕这点展开：向玩家卖游戏，向学校提供教学支持，为博物馆制作本地故事体验。先从文明航程为什么值得选择讲起。

rehearsal.en:
You've seen what Civilization Voyage feels like to play.
I'll now explain how we plan to make it a business that can keep growing.
We used Lovable to share ideas, Claude for design, Codex for APIs, and Grok for the frontend and 3D scenes.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 进入BP主线，最后一句切到第二页。
rehearsal.en:
But a working game is only the beginning.
For this project to go further, people need a reason to choose it, pay for it, and use it again.
That's what our business plan is built around.
We plan to sell the game to players, offer teaching support to schools, and build local story experiences for museums.
It all starts with what makes Civilization Voyage worth choosing.

zh: 用户为什么选择文明航程
en_script:
We chose Discovery Tour and Minecraft Education as our benchmarks.
Discovery Tour gives people detailed historical worlds to explore.
Minecraft Education gives teachers flexible tools for learning.
Our focus is a complete journey through Chinese and world histories, where each choice has an effect on what comes next.

The app already brings together four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes.
For a player, that means an adventure they can follow from beginning to end.
For a teacher, it gives them stories to build a lesson around.
For a museum, the same game tools give us a base for telling a local story.

That's the position we're building: a cultural game people can play at home, with content we can adapt for schools and museums.
The next step is to give each customer something clear to buy.
zh_script: 我们选择Discovery Tour和Minecraft Education作对标。前者提供细致的历史世界，后者提供灵活的教学工具。我们聚焦完整的中外历史航程，每次选择影响后续。App已有四时代、八航线、24场景。玩家得到可以从头玩到尾的冒险，教师得到可以组织课程的故事，博物馆则可以基于同一套工具制作本地故事。我们要建立的定位是：在家可以玩，内容也能适配学校和博物馆的文化游戏。接下来给每类客户明确的商品。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 承接上一页“为什么值得选择”，按三栏顺序讲。
rehearsal.en:
We chose Discovery Tour and Minecraft Education as our benchmarks.
Discovery Tour gives people detailed historical worlds to explore.
Minecraft Education gives teachers flexible tools for learning.
Our focus is a complete journey through Chinese and world histories, where each choice has an effect on what comes next.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指向文明航程一栏；不补充其他游戏情节。
rehearsal.en:
The app already brings together four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes.
For a player, that means an adventure they can follow from beginning to end.
For a teacher, it gives them stories to build a lesson around.
For a museum, the same game tools give us a base for telling a local story.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 读完最后一句切第三页。
rehearsal.en:
That's the position we're building: a cultural game people can play at home, with content we can adapt for schools and museums.
The next step is to give each customer something clear to buy.

en: What we sell, and who buys it
en_script:
For players, our plan is sixty-eight yuan for the full game.
They buy it because they want a good adventure. If they enjoy it, we can offer new story packs at twenty-eight yuan.
So our first job is to make a game that leaves people wanting to play more.
The next purchase then helps us pay for new content.

Schools need a different kind of help.
A teacher needs to know how to use the game in a lesson. That's why our school package includes teaching guides, two training sessions, and an agreed amount of support.
The price in our plan is twelve thousand yuan per school, per year.
I want a teacher to be able to pick it up, use it with a class, and use it again with the next one.
That repeated use gives the school a reason to renew.

For museums, we offer a project built around a local theme.
Sixty thousand yuan covers one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
We agree on the work before we start. If a museum wants more, we price that extra work separately.
The research and game tools can be used across these offers, so each sale builds on work we've already done.
That's how we plan to grow.
To make it last, we also have to keep enough money after delivering what we've sold.
zh_script: 玩家完整游戏拟价68元，玩得好再购买28元故事包。第一件事就是把游戏做好，让人还想继续玩；后续购买帮助支付新内容。学校需要教学支持，包含指南、两次培训和约定数量的帮助，计划每校每年1.2万元。我希望教师拿来能用于课堂，下个班还能再用，反复使用才有续费理由。博物馆项目围绕本地主题，6万元覆盖一个主题、三个场景、两轮审读；开始前约定工作量，新增需求另行计价。研究和工具能够共用，每笔销售建立在已有工作之上，业务由此成长。但要持续，还需要完成交付以后留下足够资金。

rehearsal.en:
For players, our plan is sixty-eight yuan for the full game.
They buy it because they want a good adventure. If they enjoy it, we can offer new story packs at twenty-eight yuan.
So our first job is to make a game that leaves people wanting to play more.
The next purchase then helps us pay for new content.

Schools need a different kind of help.
A teacher needs to know how to use the game in a lesson. That's why our school package includes teaching guides, two training sessions, and an agreed amount of support.
The price in our plan is twelve thousand yuan per school, per year.
I want a teacher to be able to pick it up, use it with a class, and use it again with the next one.
That repeated use gives the school a reason to renew.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 讲右侧文博项目，最后一句切到收入与成本。
rehearsal.en:
For museums, we offer a project built around a local theme.
Sixty thousand yuan covers one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
We agree on the work before we start. If a museum wants more, we price that extra work separately.
The research and game tools can be used across these offers, so each sale builds on work we've already done.
That's how we plan to grow.
To make it last, we also have to keep enough money after delivering what we've sold.

en: Sales must fund the next story
zh: 收入要能支持下一个故事
en_script:
Our first-year sales model brings those prices together.
Two thousand paying players, ten schools, and two museum projects give us three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan in sales.
That's the blue bar on the left.
We then pay for finding customers and delivering the work.
The green bar shows what's left: about a hundred and sixty thousand yuan.

Building the game, creating the content, and running the business takes another two hundred and forty thousand.
That leaves us almost eighty thousand yuan short in the first year.
So sales alone won't keep this business going. We also need to make each sale cost less to deliver.

Teaching guides should work across more than one class. Game tools should work across more than one museum project.
We also need to keep a close eye on how much we spend to reach each player.
A large order can use up a small team's time very quickly.
I want us to finish each project with enough money and useful work left over to start the next one.
That is why we'll put money in step by step.
zh_script: 第一年销售模型把这些价格合起来：两千名付费玩家、十所学校、两个文博项目，销售37.6万元，是左侧蓝柱。扣除获客和交付成本，绿色剩约16万元。开发游戏、制作内容、运营业务还要24万元，因此首年差接近8万元。单靠销售额无法持续，还要降低每次交付的成本。指南应能用于不止一个班，游戏工具应能用于不止一个文博项目，也要关注触达每位玩家的花费。大订单会很快占用小团队的时间。我希望每个项目完成后，都留下够用的资金和成果支持下一个项目。所以投入要分步进行。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 接住上一页“交付后留下多少”，从蓝柱往右讲。
rehearsal.en:
Our first-year sales model brings those prices together.
Two thousand paying players, ten schools, and two museum projects give us three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan in sales.
That's the blue bar on the left.
We then pay for finding customers and delivering the work.
The green bar shows what's left: about a hundred and sixty thousand yuan.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 讲固定投入和红色余额。
rehearsal.en:
Building the game, creating the content, and running the business takes another two hundred and forty thousand.
That leaves us almost eighty thousand yuan short in the first year.
So sales alone won't keep this business going. We also need to make each sale cost less to deliver.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 面向观众，讲经营判断；最后一句切到资金计划。
rehearsal.en:
Teaching guides should work across more than one class. Game tools should work across more than one museum project.
We also need to keep a close eye on how much we spend to reach each player.
A large order can use up a small team's time very quickly.
I want us to finish each project with enough money and useful work left over to start the next one.
That is why we'll put money in step by step.

zh: 先投12万元，让需求带动增长
en_script:
Our total cash plan is three hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
Most of it pays for the game and its stories. Part covers the wait between doing the work and getting paid. We also keep a reserve.
We'll release one hundred and twenty thousand yuan first.

We'll use that first stage to improve the game and see whether players finish a voyage and come back.
Then we'll work with paying schools and museums, tracking the time and cost of each project.
We'll release more funding as repeat use and paid projects show us how to grow.
Each project should leave something useful for the next one: research, a teaching guide, or a better game tool.
Over time, we'll have more stories to offer and less work to repeat.
That's how we give this project room to keep creating.
zh_script: 全年现金规划36万元，主要支持游戏和故事，一部分用于交付回款周转，同时留储备。先释放12万元，改善游戏，观察玩家能否完成并回来。再与付费学校和博物馆合作，记录每个项目的时间和成本。依据重复使用和付费项目的成果释放更多资金。每个项目都要留下有用的研究、教学指南或游戏工具。慢慢就有更多故事可以提供，也减少重复劳动，让项目拥有持续创作的空间。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 从全年资金转到首期投入。
rehearsal.en:
Our total cash plan is three hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
Most of it pays for the game and its stories. Part covers the wait between doing the work and getting paid. We also keep a reserve.
We'll release one hundred and twenty thousand yuan first.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 沿右侧步骤讲，最后一句切到结尾画面。
rehearsal.en:
We'll use that first stage to improve the game and see whether players finish a voyage and come back.
Then we'll work with paying schools and museums, tracking the time and cost of each project.
We'll release more funding as repeat use and paid projects show us how to grow.
Each project should leave something useful for the next one: research, a teaching guide, or a better game tool.
Over time, we'll have more stories to offer and less work to repeat.
That's how we give this project room to keep creating.

en_script:
And that's what our business plan comes back to: giving good stories the time and money to continue.
Civilization Voyage starts with Chinese civilization and takes us out into the world.
We see how new tools change people's lives, and how people choose to use them.
Those choices matter in the game. They matter just as much in the world we're building today.
We can build faster ships.
We still have to choose where they take us.
Let's choose a future worth arriving in.
Thank you.
zh_script: 商业计划最终回到这一点：让好故事拥有继续讲下去的时间和资金。文明航程从中华文明出发，带我们走向世界。我们看到新工具怎样改变人的生活，也看到人们怎样选择使用它。选择在游戏中重要，在今天共同建设的世界中同样重要。我们可以造出更快的船，驶向何方仍由我们选择。愿我们驶向的未来值得抵达。谢谢。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 切到神殿航船画面。最后几句放慢，句间自然停顿。
rehearsal.en:
And that's what our business plan comes back to: giving good stories the time and money to continue.
Civilization Voyage starts with Chinese civilization and takes us out into the world.
We see how new tools change people's lives, and how people choose to use them.
Those choices matter in the game. They matter just as much in the world we're building today.
We can build faster ships.
We still have to choose where they take us.
Let's choose a future worth arriving in.
Thank you.
